topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
response: Increasing array size (from 16 to 64 sub-arrays) leads to a decline in radiation efficiency, dropping from 70% to 27.5%. This decrease is attributed to the increased length of the SIW structures, resulting in higher insertion loss.
reference_context: The study investigates the relationship between array scale and efficiency. Experimentally fabricated SIW sub-arrays with different sizes reveal a trade-off between array size and radiation efficiency. As array size increases, efficiency decreases, primarily due to increased insertion loss.
